question: Find Melanoma trials with minimum follow‑up and show months by arm.

gemini.answer: This SQL query selects Melanoma trials, listing their NCT, author, year, PubMed ID, and follow-up durations, ordered by the overall follow-up duration in ascending order to show the minimum follow-up.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\", \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\", \"follow_up_duration_control_months\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Melanoma%'\nORDER BY \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" ASC;",
```
